summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing a market notice for a public offering of its 11th issue of simple, non-convertible, unsecured debentures. The offering is for 500,000 debentures with a unit par value of R$1,000.00, totaling R$500 million, issued July 15, 2026. It is an automatic registration procedure offering exclusively to professional investors, with BTG Pactual and XP Investimentos as coordinators. No special-situation event is described; this is a routine debt capital markets transaction.
